record.summary: daemon start|stop|status|plist: a detached child process running the watch command with db persistence and NO_COLOR, both stdio streams appended to data/daemon.log, a plain-decimal pidfile at data/daemon.pid, single-SIGTERM stop, kill(pid, 0) liveness probing with stale-pidfile detection, and a launchd plist that is printed to stdout and never installed (installing a launch agent is the user's call).
record.title: Background watcher daemon (pidfile lifecycle, plist print-only)
